headline: Parsvnath Developers Limited notifies 2nd COC meeting under CIRP
sum: Parsvnath Developers Limited, a listed real estate developer, intimated the NSE of its second Committee of Creditors meeting in its ongoing Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process. The disclosure signals progression through the statutory creditor approval framework under the IBC 2016.
detail: Parsvnath Developers Limited, a listed real estate developer in the National Capital Region, has filed formal intimation with the National Stock Exchange regarding the convening of its second Committee of Creditors meeting within its ongoing CIRP. Under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code 2016, the CoC must meet to evaluate the Insolvency Professional's progress, review resolution plans if submitted, and decide on key procedural matters including extension of the corporate insolvency resolution period or transition to liquidation. The NSE filing establishes public disclosure compliance and provides creditors, investors, and other stakeholders visibility into the statutory process timeline.
